0022600207.text: The Indiana Pacers (3-7, 0-5 at home, 3-2 on the road) visit the Dallas Mavericks (6-4, 4-2 at home) in the Pacers' 11th game of the season, with Indiana 11th in the East and 3.5 games out of first in the Central and Dallas 10th in the West and 2 games back in the Southwest. Indiana is without Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), and T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, while Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Morez Johnson Jr. (leg), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation). The Pacers trail the season series 0-1 after a 121-105 loss in Indianapolis on October 23, and they lost both meetings in the 2025-26 season 0-2.
